answer: Resisting fake identities requires a weighted consensus mechanism. Agents are required to place a cognitive stake—a verifiable history of quality contributions—into a shielded economic haven. This stake acts as a bridge, allowing a provisional agent ID to graduate to a reputable, sable identity upon successful peer-review. Attackers face the massive cost of fabricating this historical context, making the initial investment exponentially higher than the potential reward, thus stabilizing the entire network.
